column1: # Where the old product name may still appear after the rebrand to "Clarae notanda" (ADR-0052).
# Checked by scripts/rebrand/check.mjs (task lint-brand): an occurrence that no line here covers
# fails, and so does a line that no longer covers anything: this list can only get shorter.
#   glob   path from the repository root; ** crosses directories
#   regex  JavaScript, case-sensitive, matched on one line: the old name is allowed inside a match.
#          * allows the whole file and its path
#   class  frozen   never renamed: changing it breaks existing data
#          legacy   compatibility with data and clients of 1.x; the reason names the release that drops it
#          fixture  test data in the format 1.x wrote
#          history  records of the time: not rewritten
#          external a name that is not ours to change here
